note: 2026-09-15 FOLLOW-UP BATCH, and the LAST relay batch of this session regardless of what it returns - I declare that cap before firing so the day cannot drift into open-ended probing. EPISTEMIC STATUS, DECLARED HONESTLY: this batch was DESIGNED BY THE RESEARCH ANALYST and is fired by the chairman AFTER both seats' returns were entered in the record verbatim and AFTER the integrity officer vetted them. It is NOT session-open pre-registration and must never be cited as such. THE FOUR ROWS, THE URL SPELLING AND THE FILE NAME ARE THE ANALYST'S, UNALTERED. WHAT IS MINE, AND IT IS A CORRECTION RATHER THAN A DESIGN CHANGE: the analyst registered row 2 as buying 'zero new characters', and integrity objection 0915-B2 establishes that the yield formula it used is incomplete - excerpt_of centres a 400-character window at [p-100, p+300), so a candidate window gains max(0, d-100) characters RIGHTWARD and max(0, 100-d) characters LEFTWARD against a held window, and the analyst omitted the leftward term entirely. I SUSTAIN 0915-B2 AND CORRECT ROW 2'S REGISTRATION HERE, BEFORE ANY RESULT IS SEEN, rather than let a mis-registration be graded as if it had been right. WHY THIS BATCH EXISTS: today's session-open batch returned an annulment-chronology window cut mid-sentence at 'February 25, 2026 The ad hoc Committee issues a decision' - cut by OUR OWN EXCERPT_CHARS=400 cap at scripts/fetch_relay.py:42, not by the page - and the relative order of the page's two 'Status of Proceeding' fields is the unobserved fact on which the whole Pending-attribution question turns. THE FIRST-OCCURRENCE TEST AND THE AMENDMENT I ADOPT TODAY. The test as adopted 2026-09-14 bars a literal whose first occurrence falls inside an already-committed window. Rows 1 and 2 below fall inside held windows and the test as written bars both. The analyst asked me to amend the test; the integrity officer found the analyst's argument for the amendment defective in two of its three supports - 0915-B1 (the claimed collision with the 2026-08-31 four-row chain DOES NOT EXIST: that chain is a GAP-TARGETING design and three of its four rows pass the test as written, which I verified at analytics/daily-research/2026-08-31.md:616, 'Every window carries its literal at offset exactly 100') and 0915-B4a/0915-B5 (the prior-art screens supporting it were mis-described, and four of six of its zeros dissolve on the first synonym). I THEREFORE REJECT THE AMENDMENT AS THE ANALYST DRAFTED IT AND ADOPT THE INTEGRITY OFFICER'S NARROW FORM INSTEAD, which binds from today: a literal whose first occurrence falls inside a held window is barred UNLESS the candidate window [p-100, p+300) is shown BY ASSEMBLY to extend beyond the held on-state run at either edge, and the extension is stated in characters before the row is registered. Rows 1 and 2 are admitted under that narrow form and under nothing wider. THE COMPANION RULING, SUSTAINED AGAINST ME: today's session-open row 1 ('(b) Annulment') FAILED the first-occurrence test and my committed request note asserted it passed. I applied the spent-pair test where I had said the occurrence test governed. Verified by me against the blobs before ruling: '(b) Annulment' occurs verbatim in blob e749584b3435043764e6b2dea3ca3532799a8eb7 records[2] and records[3], both committed 2026-09-13; today's row-1 window is WHOLLY CONTAINED in the stitched union of e749584b records[3] and 02d1ff146f0ccc251ffc149a048abda76c186897 records[2] at suffix/prefix overlap 282, union 518, containment True. That row bought ZERO new characters. THE FIX BINDS FROM TODAY: a candidate literal is screened against the ASSEMBLED ON-STATE RUN of every committed window for that page, never against the list of spent finds and never against a single window. OFFSETS RE-DERIVED BY ME AT THE MOMENT OF THIS CLAIM against blob 67f79d6ae697ccc731411815214714e4876e7b53 records[2], window length exactly 400: 'Article 52' d=100 (yield 0 both ways, which is why it is not re-fired); 'February 25, 2026' d=344; 'Committee issues a decision' d=373; 'issues a decision' d=383, rightward yield 283. NAMING CONSTRAINT, re-derived at the moment of this claim and not carried from any earlier moment in this session - this is the mechanism that falsified the 2026-09-13 pre-registration: newest_request() at scripts/fetch_relay.py:233-235 (the analyst's correction of my :232-234 is right and I sustain 0915-N4) takes sorted(glob('*.json'))[-1] and the workflow passes no --request. Over the 62 files now in analytics/fetch-requests/ the lexicographic maximum is 2026-09-15-daily.json, and '2026-09-15-zz-decision-subject-and-status-order.json' > '2026-09-15-daily.json' is True. FORECASTS REGISTERED IN ADVANCE ON EVERY ROW. ROW 1 'issues a decision' - find_matched TRUE is NEAR-GUARANTEED and is NOT SCORED (the string sits in a window we hold; that is the NOT-TESTABLE condition and I declare it rather than bank it). The two TESTABLE registrations are the analyst's and I keep them unaltered: (a) the window will contain text absent from this corpus - HIGH, on the 283-character rightward arithmetic; (b) that occurrence IS the page's first - LOW, because the original proceeding's chronology between 30 April 2025 and the 28 July 2025 award is unobserved and may contain an earlier 'The Tribunal issues a decision'. BOTH BRANCHES PAY: the forecast branch delivers the 25 February 2026 decision's subject; the failure branch centres a window on a Tribunal decision in the original proceeding, which is the region where the Rule 41(1) objection's disposition would sit. PRE-DISARMED, ABSOLUTELY: whatever returns is a DOCKET SENTENCE. No document may be characterised as deciding anything unless the window's own words say so; 'issues a decision on X' states a SUBJECT, never an OUTCOME; and the standing rule that 'concerning the continuation of the stay' is not 'continued the stay' governs every word of it. ROW 2 'Status of Proceeding' - the analyst registers that the first occurrence carries 'Concluded' at LOW (recording its untutored credence as MODERATE-HIGH), and I keep that forecast unaltered. CORRECTED BY ME PER 0915-B2: the analyst's 'this row buys zero new characters' is WITHDRAWN AND REPLACED - the row buys 68 characters LEFTWARD if the first occurrence is the 'Pending' one (d=32) and 32 characters LEFTWARD if it is the 'Concluded' one (d=68 against the assembled 582-character da8b441f run), and that leftward text sits immediately before a status block, which is precisely the region the analyst's own section 2.1 declares unobserved and section 2.3 declares decisive. PRE-DISARMED: whichever value returns, this fixes ORDER ONLY. It does not state attribution. Attribution still runs through taxonomy 37 plus the heading positions and the record must say so in those words. IF THE FIRST OCCURRENCE CARRIES 'Pending', THE ANNULMENT ATTRIBUTION IS WRONG AND THE 2026-09-14 RULING MUST BE RE-TAKEN. ROW 3 '52(1)' - find_matched FALSE, LOW. Passes the first-occurrence test as written: '52(1)' screens to 0 files corpus-wide, so it cannot match inside any window this project holds. Both outcomes pay - a null is a census (the string occurs nowhere in the page's visible text, so the docket states no ground in that form anywhere), a match centres on a grounds recital. NAMED DEFEATER: any entity, markup or space between the characters defeats the literal, and this page is confirmed to insert entities inside phrases. PRE-DISARMED: the presence of a citation is NOT a ground pleaded, decided or asserted by any party, and no ground may be inferred from a reference's existence. ROW 4 'Construction' - POSITIVE CONTROL, declared, not a prediction, not scored. A spent pair that buys no window; what it buys is validation of the find-instrument on THIS batch's byte-stream in THE SAME RUN as rows 1-3, so that row 3's null - the only null this batch can produce - is a validated null. WHOLE-PAGE FORECAST, registered once and graded once, riding on all four rows: predicted bytes 98122, HIGH (the figure has held on every observation across 09-13, 09-14 and 09-15); predicted sha256 EQUAL to d972c70f85f55c3a... if this batch fires on 2026-09-15, MODERATE-HIGH, and DIFFERENT from it if it fires on any later calendar date, MODERATE-HIGH. Exactly one branch will be graded. That the four rows return an identical sha256 TO EACH OTHER within one run is NEAR-GUARANTEED, of low evidential value, and is registered as such rather than scored. BINDING READING RULE, carried unchanged for a tenth batch: any window returned may contain case names, case numbers, document types and dates belonging to matters this project is not researching. NONE may be entered as a discovered matter, screened, graded on any ring, or carried as a lead, including in any candidate-claims block. This instrument retrieves what the record already identified; it is not a discovery channel (METHODOLOGY Part VIII). WHAT THIS BATCH CANNOT DO, stated so nobody expects it: it cannot reach the ground or the reasoning of the 28 July 2025 award, the BODY of the 25 February 2026 decision, or the text of Procedural Order No. 3 - those live on documents excerpt_of discards for content type at scripts/fetch_relay.py:124-125. It cannot establish what any order or decision DECIDED; the docket gives subjects, not outcomes. It cannot close limb (ii) of the Spentech thread and no batch anyone can design against this docket can. It cannot settle the Pending attribution by itself - at best it settles the ordering on which that attribution depends. And it cannot touch ring 1, ring 2 or ring 3 of this project's research question: this docket is a construction dispute on ICSID's own fields, the theme was quiet today, and nothing in this batch will change that.
